attributes.carries: a licence book gone soft at the corners from salt
attributes.fears: being made obsolete before she chooses to stop
attributes.tell: counts water barrels twice, always, even when she has just counted them
attributes.voice: clipped, concrete, allergic to ceremony; says 'we' when she means an order, and answers questions with instructions
attributes.wants: one last clean crossing, then out

name: Ysoly Tamm
summary: Caravan master out of Bell Harrow, fifty-four, thirty years on the salt and one crossing short of the retirement the Assembly owes her. She can price a load, a route and a person in the same breath, and she runs her train on the assumption that the plain is indifferent rather than cruel. What she wants is a clean last crossing and a roof that does not move; what she is afraid of is finding out that the Road stopped needing her before she stopped needing it.
